content: PDF extraction: PyMuPDF 1.28.0 / pymupdf4llm 1.28.0 is ~0.01s/page, 10-50x faster than pdfplumber/pypdf on digital text PDFs, but is AGPL-3.0 (commercial license required for closed-source SaaS). pypdf 6.14.2 is BSD-3, pure Python, adequate for digital-text PDFs, weak on tables/layout, no OCR. docling 2.117.0 is Apache-2.0, handles scanned PDFs via OCR and preserves table structure, but is heavy (torch models) and slow. None of the pure parsers extract anything from scanned image PDFs.
